messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: disconnect from server shiny without any error, works locally fine
parts:
Sriram,
If you can reproduce the issue, it would be helpful for you to open up a ticket with shinyapps-support and provide any steps that you have, we will be sure to hop on and see if we can figure out what is going on.  
I would include your account id, your application URL, and the steps taken to reproduce the issue.  Also, if you could check and see if you see any errors from the javascript console within the browser when the disconnect occurs, it would help.

Best,
Tareef
